errors.evidence: The figure does not show PST as the highest bar in every group; for several categories (e.g., TextCNN, FL, RFL, CB, DB, HTTN, LACO) Teacher or Self-Training exceeds or matches PST depending on the group.
In the DB group, the bars are approximately Teacher 57, Self-Training 60-61, PST 62-63; Teacher is not as high as 58 and the other values are slightly overstated.
CLS values are approximately Teacher 34, Self-Training 30-31, PST 41, so the stated values are only approximate and slightly imprecise.
